title: 第十三章 都住402第十四章 男澡堂去哪里了
content_zh:
最新网址：“我也是啊！”王跃心情比较复杂，虽然没看过这部剧，但也肯定这个小美女应该是剧情人物之一。
不过咱家的咸鱼影视系统感觉不需要知道剧情的，又没有做任务，顺其自然就好。
“真的假的？你不会是土木系吧。”郑微挣大萌萌的大眼睛，秋水剪瞳里面写的都是不可置信。
“是啊！”王跃非常认真的看着郑微，似乎在说我都这么的认真了，这事情肯定是真的，你要相信我！
郑微还是觉得不可能这么巧，但也没有再做纠缠，毕竟一会报到的地方肯定能验明正身的。如果敢骗我，我会让这小子知道欺骗我玉面小飞龙的代价。
“我郑微，你叫啥？”郑微直接问。
“记住了，我是王跃！”王跃随口应付着……
俩人就这么唠着嗑，跟着人流缓缓的走在笔直的林荫小道。在小道两侧，各个专业的学长们，拜访着小桌子，作为新生接待。
就在俩人慢慢的左寻右找的时候，有两个一脸热情笑容，一看就不是大一的学生走过来，对着郑微询问，仿佛王跃这178的壮汉，就是一个木桩似的，“你新生吧？你是那个系的。”
郑微老老实实的回答，“是啊，我是土木工程的啊！”
“土木工程的吗？那也算是我的师妹了。我们就是负责新生接待的，跟我走吧！”仿佛是这一刻才看到旁边的王跃似的，看到王跃拉的两个箱子，询问道，“那个行李是师妹的，给我吧！”
王跃看了一眼郑微，就松开了右手的行李箱，两人中脸上有青春痘的还在热情的还在和郑微套话。另一个比较矮的那个热情过来的随手一拉，箱子晃了一下，还是放在哪里。
郑微不好意思的说，“轮子下火车的时候，坏掉了。”
“还挺沉的啊，放心师哥别看瘦，但是有肌肉啊！”说完用力的还是真的提起了箱子。然后咬牙切齿的说，“师妹咋称呼，我是宫成！”
“对啊，师妹，我是张开！咱们先去找到宿舍，把行李安置好，再来办这些复杂的程序。”有青春痘那个一边自我介绍，一边给出了建议。
“我啊，郑微！”说着就跟着两人向前走了。走了几步，就发现王跃竟然没跟上。
王跃看到郑微扭头看向他，就冲他微微的挥了挥手，然后就往右前方的桌子走了过去。
郑微一看王跃竟然就那么走了，咬牙切齿的冲他的背影挥了挥拳头。这小子竟然敢骗我，看我下次遇见你怎么修理你。
王跃找到报到的地方填写资料的时候，就听桌子边一个师兄大声冲不远处准备悄悄的走开的人说，“老张，运气不错啊！小师妹那个系的啊！”
青春痘男生得意的一笑，“土木系的小师妹！”

他的话音一落，就听到迎新的人里有人嚷了起来，“张开，你这人也太狼了吧！那是我们建筑工程学院的！刚有几个你们环境工程学院的几个新生站哪里，你们都不去搭理！”
“都一样，都一样的！我们环境工程不是也合并进入了建筑工程了吗！大家不分彼此！”张开一脸的你们不要那么见外吗！
郑微在哪里偷偷的笑，作为青春无敌的美少女，这个时候一定要缄默。不过就在这个时候，他看到了人群中，坐在第一排填资料的王跃。难道说这家伙没有骗自己？
王跃填好资料，就准备按部就班的办理入学手续。结果一转身，就看到郑微在人群中冲他微笑。还别说，有那么一瞬间，小心脏砰砰的乱跳起来。
“我在男生宿舍402，你不过来看看，还准备去宿管阿姨哪里找啊！”王跃才不承认自己的刚才被晃的出神呢。
正在装作一个安静美女的郑微，听了这话就走了过来，填了资料后，就发现自己的宿舍竟然也是402，当然是女生宿舍。
王跃侧身看了一眼，就口花花的说，“哎呀，这么巧！咱俩都住402啊！”
“呸，我这是女生宿舍，有本事你来啊！看阿姨不打死你！”郑微说完就转身走了，只是略微泛红的耳朵出卖了她。
张开和宫成原本以为美女跑了呢，结果看到美女又走了回来，赶紧殷勤的指引着郑微走了！
王跃乐呵呵的看着他们离去后，才拉着自己的行李，往自己的宿舍楼而去。
王跃进宿舍的时候，发现宿舍没有人，但也就剩下一个床铺是空闲的。王跃也不挑剔，就赶紧开始整理自己的东西。
等王跃办理完毕入学手续后，再次回到宿舍之后，发现所有的人都在了。
三个人看到王跃，坐在门右侧靠窗位置的一个清瘦男孩，戴着眼睛看起来斯斯文文的。男孩站起来后，推了下眼镜后说，“我是张洋！南河省河洛人！”
坐在他对面的一个同样瘦瘦的男孩，听完张洋的话说，“我韩文，西江人。”
右侧靠门一个胖胖的男孩，本来也转过身来，对王跃说，“我是刘磊，南河省新阳人。”
“我是王跃，北河人！我是土木工程系的！”王跃把肩上的背包扔到自己的床上，“马上19岁了！你们呢？”
张洋笑呵呵的说道：“我们几个在你回来以前已经讨论过了，咱们都是土木工程的。你应该最大！我9月的生日！他俩都不到18，一个二月，一个三月”
“好吧，那以后我就是老大啦！放心，我会照顾好你们的！小弟们！”王跃心情十分好。
不一会大家都不那么陌生了，寝室里慢慢的。也开始热闹起来。
经过几天磕磕喷喷的上课经历，大家对学校的环境有那么的一点的熟悉。这天晚上宿舍四个人在图书馆磨蹭的有点久，回到宿舍竟然没热水了。一问才知道这个热水是定时供应。

“话说，咱们去公共澡堂洗澡去吧，这都一身汗！”王跃发出了他晋升老大后的第一个建议。
“好吧！我一开始还想在宿舍冲下凉水呢！”最小的小胖刘磊笑眯眯的应和着。
“行！”老二张洋
“那走吧！咱们见识下大学澡堂是啥样的！”老三韩文
洗澡四人组一路谈笑，晃晃悠悠的走到了澡堂门口。结果远远的就看到郑微手提着洗漱用品也走了过来。最新网址：

Latest website: "Me too!" Wang Yue's mood was complicated. Although he had not watched this drama, he was sure that this little beauty should be one of the characters in the plot.
However, our Xianyu film and television system feels that there is no need to know the plot, and there is no task to do, so just let nature take its course.
"Really or not? You're not from the civil engineering department, are you?" Zheng Wei's big, cute eyes were full of disbelief.
"Yes!" Wang Yue looked at Zheng Wei very seriously, as if to say that I am so serious, this must be true, you have to believe me!
Zheng Wei still felt that it couldn't be such a coincidence, but he didn't pester him anymore. After all, he would definitely be able to verify his identity when he reported in later. If you dare to lie to me, I will let this kid know the price of cheating my jade-faced little flying dragon.
"I'm Zheng Wei, what's your name?" Zheng Wei asked directly.
"Remember, I am Wang Yue!" Wang Yue responded casually...
The two of them just chatted and walked slowly along the straight tree-lined path with the flow of people. On both sides of the path, seniors from various majors visited small tables to receive new students.
Just as the two of them were slowly looking around, two students with enthusiastic smiles on their faces, who looked like they were not freshmen, came over and asked Zheng Wei, as if Wang Yue, a 178-year-old strong man, was just a wooden stake, "Are you a freshman? Which department are you in?"
Zheng Wei answered honestly, "Yes, I work in civil engineering!"
"Are you from civil engineering? That can be considered my junior sister. We are responsible for welcoming new students. Come with me!" As if he only saw Wang Yue next to him at this moment, he saw the two boxes Wang Yue pulled and asked, "That luggage belongs to my junior sister, give it to me!"
Wang Yue glanced at Zheng Wei and let go of the suitcase in his right hand. The one with acne on his face was still talking to Zheng Wei enthusiastically. The other, shorter one came over enthusiastically and pulled it casually. The box shook a bit, but it was still placed where it was.
Zheng Wei said embarrassedly, "The wheels were broken when we got off the train."
"It's quite heavy. Don't worry, senior brother, you may not look thin, but you have muscles!" After saying that, he really lifted the box. Then he gritted his teeth and said, "What do you call me, junior sister? I am Gong Cheng!"
"Yes, junior sister, I'm open to it! Let's find the dormitory first, put our luggage in place, and then go through these complicated procedures." The one with acne introduced himself and gave suggestions.
"It's me, Zheng Wei!" He said and followed the two of them forward. After walking a few steps, he found that Wang Yue had not followed.
When Wang Yue saw Zheng Wei turning to look at him, he waved slightly to him, and then walked towards the table on the right front.
When Zheng Wei saw Wang Yue just leaving like that, she gritted her teeth and waved her fist at his back. How dare this kid lie to me and see how I can fix you next time I meet you.
When Wang Yue found the registration place and filled out the information, he heard a senior brother at the table shouting to the person not far away who was about to walk away quietly, "Lao Zhang, you are lucky! Junior sister is in that department!"
The boy with acne smiled proudly, "Junior sister from the civil engineering department!"
As soon as he finished speaking, someone among the welcoming people shouted, "Zhang Zhang, you are such a wolf! Those are from our School of Architectural Engineering! There were a few freshmen from your School of Environmental Engineering standing there just now, but you didn't even bother to pay attention!"
"It's all the same, it's all the same! Didn't our environmental project also merge into the construction project? We don't distinguish between each other!" Don't be so open-minded!
Zheng Wei secretly smiled. As a young and invincible beautiful girl, she must remain silent at this time. But at this moment, he saw Wang Yue in the crowd, sitting in the first row filling out information. Could it be that this guy didn't lie to himself?
Wang Yue filled out the information and prepared to go through the admission procedures step by step. The result changedWhen he turned around, he saw Zheng Wei smiling at him in the crowd. Not to mention, for a moment, my little heart started beating wildly.
"I'm in room 402 of the boys' dormitory. If you don't come over and take a look, you're going to look for the dormitory aunt!" Wang Yue refused to admit that he was so distracted just now.
Zheng Wei, who was pretending to be a quiet beauty, came over after hearing this. After filling in the information, she found that her dormitory was also 402, of course it was a girls dormitory.
Wang Yue glanced sideways and said nonchalantly, "Oh, what a coincidence! We both live in 402!"
"Bah, this is a girls' dormitory, come if you can! Let's see if Auntie doesn't beat you to death!" After Zheng Wei said that, she turned around and left, but her slightly red ears gave her away.
Zhang Zhang and Gong Cheng originally thought that the beauty had run away, but when they saw the beauty coming back, they quickly and diligently guided Zheng Wei away!
Wang Yue watched them leave happily, then took his luggage and headed towards his dormitory building.
When Wang Yue entered the dormitory, he found that there was no one in the dormitory, but there was only one bed left free. Wang Yue was not picky and quickly started to organize his things.
After Wang Yue completed the admission procedures, he returned to the dormitory and found that everyone was there.
The three of them saw Wang Yue, a thin boy sitting by the window on the right side of the door. He wore glasses and looked gentle. After the boy stood up, he pushed up his glasses and said, "I am Zhang Yang! I am from Heluo, Nanhe Province!"
An equally skinny boy sitting opposite him said after hearing Zhang Yang's words, "I'm Korean and from Xijiang."
A fat boy by the door on the right turned around and said to Wang Yue, "I am Liu Lei, from Xinyang, Nanhe Province."
"I'm Wang Yue, from Beihe! I'm from the Department of Civil Engineering!" Wang Yue threw the backpack on his shoulder on his bed, "I'm going to be 19 years old soon! What about you?"
Zhang Yang said with a smile: "We have discussed it before you came back. We are all civil engineering. You should be the oldest! My birthday is in September! They are both under 18, one is in February and the other is in March."
"Okay, then I will be the boss from now on! Don't worry, I will take good care of you! Little brothers!" Wang Yue was in a very good mood.
After a while, everyone was no longer so strange, and slowly in the dormitory. It also started to get lively.
After a few days of bumpy class experience, everyone is somewhat familiar with the school environment. That night, the four people in the dormitory lingered in the library for a long time. When they returned to the dormitory, there was no hot water. After asking, I found out that the hot water is supplied on a regular basis.
"By the way, let's go take a bath in the public bathhouse. We're all sweaty!" Wang Yue made his first suggestion after being promoted to boss.
"Okay! I wanted to take a cold shower in the dormitory at first!" the youngest and chubby Liu Lei responded with a smile.
"Okay!" Zhang Yang, the second oldest
"Let's go then! Let's see what the university bathhouse is like!" The third child in Korean
The foursome took a bath, chatting and laughing all the way, and wandered to the door of the bathhouse. As a result, from a distance, Zheng Wei was seen walking over with toiletries in hand. Latest website:
